name: Production Autonomous AI Agent & Swarm Stack
target_audience: AI Engineers, Autonomous System Architects, Applied AI Startups & Enterprise R&D
summary: Battle-tested, enterprise-grade architecture for building deterministic multi-agent swarms with cyclical graph orchestration, low-latency hybrid vector retrieval, and comprehensive tracing observability.
architecture_overview: Production AI agents require strict state machines rather than unconstrained loops. By combining LangGraph cyclical state graphs with DSPy algorithmic prompt optimization, Qdrant high-speed vector retrieval, and Langfuse tracing with DeepEval automated evaluation, teams eliminate hallucination loops, maintain sub-second tool execution, and enforce enterprise safety guardrails.

tiers.name: Agent Reasoning & Prompt Optimization Framework
tiers.purpose: Define agent persona, structured input/output contracts, and programmatic prompt compilation.

primary_component.role: Algorithmic prompt optimization & assertion-driven module compiler
primary_component.why_chosen: Replaces brittle hand-written prompts with self-optimizing pipelines and strict output schema constraints.
primary_component.trade_offs: Steeper learning curve than raw OpenAI SDK; requires validation metrics to compile effectively.

alternative_components.trade_offs: Highly dynamic conversations can be harder to unit test than static graph nodes.
Focuses purely on schema extraction rather than multi-step agent planning.

tiers.name: Cyclic State Graph & Multi-Agent Orchestrator
tiers.purpose: Manage multi-agent workflows, branching logic, persistent memory checkpoints, and human-in-the-loop interventions.

primary_component.role: Stateful multi-actor agent orchestrator with cyclical graphs and checkpointing
primary_component.why_chosen: Native support for cycles, branching, time-travel debugging, and durable persistence out-of-the-box.
primary_component.trade_offs: Requires explicit state schema management; more boilerplate for trivial one-shot tasks.

alternative_components.trade_offs: Higher abstraction level; less granular control over custom state transition hooks.
Heavy opinionated software development role structures.

tiers.name: High-Performance Vector DB & Hybrid Search
tiers.purpose: Index semantic knowledge embeddings, enterprise documentation, and long-term agent memory with sub-10ms latency.

primary_component.role: Rust-native vector search engine with payload-based filtering
primary_component.why_chosen: Extremely fast HNSW indexing, rich metadata payload filtering, and lightweight standalone binary deployment.
primary_component.trade_offs: Requires dedicated server instance or managed cluster compared to embedded in-memory options.

alternative_components.role: Cloud-native distributed vector database for billion-scale collections
alternative_components.trade_offs: Significantly heavier operational footprint (requires etcd, MinIO, Pulsar/Kafka).

alternative_components.role: Simple embedded vector database for fast prototyping
alternative_components.trade_offs: Higher write latency at massive concurrency; optimized for smaller memory scopes.

tiers.name: LLM Observability, Tracing & Guardrail Evaluation
tiers.purpose: Capture full invocation traces, latency breakdowns, token costs, prompt revisions, and automated evaluation metrics.

primary_component.role: Open-source LLM engineering platform for traces, evaluations, and prompt management
primary_component.why_chosen: Full OpenTelemetry-native trace visualization, playground experimentation, cost tracking, and easy self-hosting.
primary_component.trade_offs: Requires Postgres and ClickHouse backend for enterprise scale deployments.

alternative_components.role: Unit testing and CI/CD quality gate evaluation for LLM outputs
alternative_components.trade_offs: Specialized in testing/eval metrics rather than real-time production request tracing.

alternative_components.role: AI observability and evals with OpenInference telemetry
alternative_components.trade_offs: Notebook-centric evaluation focus, different dashboard workflow.

end_to_end_workflow: Natural Language Goal -> DSPy Pipeline Compilation -> LangGraph Multi-Agent State Machine -> Qdrant Hybrid Semantic Retrieval -> Tool Invocation via MCP -> Output Verification via DeepEval -> Telemetry Tracing in Langfuse

data_flow_stages.title: Goal Ingestion & Constraint Compilation
data_flow_stages.input: User goal and runtime execution constraints
data_flow_stages.output: Structured Pydantic task graph and compiled prompt signature
data_flow_stages.verification: Ensure prompt signature passes DSPy assertions and zero-shot validation tests.

data_flow_stages.title: Stateful Multi-Agent Orchestration
data_flow_stages.input: Compiled task graph and initial global state
data_flow_stages.output: Branching execution steps with intermediate agent checkpointing
data_flow_stages.verification: Detect and short-circuit cyclic infinite loops with max_iterations bounds.

data_flow_stages.title: Contextual Retrieval & Long-Term Memory
data_flow_stages.input: Agent sub-task query and tenant filter metadata
data_flow_stages.output: Ranked semantic context chunks with cosine similarity > 0.82
data_flow_stages.verification: Benchmark retrieval recall@k (>0.90) and verify tenant isolation keys.

data_flow_stages.title: Observability Tracing & Automated Eval Gate
data_flow_stages.input: Completed agent state, generation tokens, and tool call logs
data_flow_stages.output: Audited trace URL, latency metrics, and G-Eval alignment score
data_flow_stages.verification: Quality gate rejects agent outputs with hallucination score > 0.15.

production_readiness.sla_target: 99.9% agent API availability with p95 tool execution latency < 2.5s
security_considerations: Strict sanitization of untrusted web/document content to prevent prompt injection
Scoped ephemeral credentials for all tool executions
Zero egress leakage of internal prompts or system schemas to client responses
Tenant-isolated collection partitioning in Qdrant with API key boundaries

failure_modes_and_mitigations.failure_mode: Agent reasoning loops indefinitely on ambiguous tasks
failure_modes_and_mitigations.mitigation: Enforce strict LangGraph recursion limit and fallback to human-in-the-loop escalation node.

failure_modes_and_mitigations.failure_mode: Vector DB latency spikes during peak indexing bursts
failure_modes_and_mitigations.mitigation: Isolate write ingestion into asynchronous background worker queues with Qdrant replication.

failure_modes_and_mitigations.failure_mode: LLM provider rate limits or service outage
failure_modes_and_mitigations.mitigation: Deploy LiteLLM proxy router with automatic multi-provider fallback (Anthropic -> OpenAI -> local vLLM).

setup_commands: pip install langgraph dspy-ai qdrant-client langfuse deepeval
quickstart.sample_config_or_code:
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, END
from typing import TypedDict, Annotated
import dspy

class AgentState(TypedDict):
    input: str
    plan: list[str]
    results: dict
    final_answer: str

def planner_node(state: AgentState):
    # DSPy compiled module invocation
    return {'plan': ['step1_fetch_context', 'step2_synthesize']}

def executor_node(state: AgentState):
    return {'results': {'summary': 'Task executed successfully'}}

builder = StateGraph(AgentState)
builder.add_node('planner', planner_node)
builder.add_node('executor', executor_node)
builder.set_entry_point('planner')
builder.add_edge('planner', 'executor')
builder.add_edge('executor', END)
graph = builder.compile()
